prompts.prompt: Edit this exact photo. 1) Completely remove the white caption box with black Korean text in the middle of the image and fill that area naturally with the pool water, poolside and white lounge chair that would be behind it. 2) Restore it as a sharp, high-resolution, clean photograph: remove video compression artifacts and blur, natural colors. Keep the composition, camera angle, scenery (mountains, sky, cabana loungers, patterned wall, pool), the person's pose, clothes, hands, book and watch exactly the same. Keep the person's face fully blurred/unrecognizable exactly as in the original - do not reveal or invent a face. Do not add any text, letters or logos.
